app.name: Societal Innovation Portal
app.tagline: Local problems, routed to the people who can solve them.

home.eyebrow: Department of Higher & Technical Education · Government of Jharkhand
home.heading: Tell us what needs fixing where you live.
home.body: Describe the problem in your own words. It is categorised automatically and sent to the university or industry partner whose expertise actually fits — and you can follow what happens next.

steps.heading: How a report gets to the right people

step1.title: You describe it
step1.body: Plain language, no form fields to guess right. A photo and location help but are never required.

step2.title: It gets classified and matched
step2.body: An AI classifier reads the description, assigns a subject area, and ranks the university and industry partners whose expertise actually fits.

step3.title: An institution claims it
step3.body: A matched partner takes ownership, and the report's status is tracked publicly through to resolution.

demo.heading: From a citizen's problem to a matched institution
demo.intro: This is how it actually works, dramatized with an example — the same matching that runs on every real report you can see on the challenges page.
demo.problem: Canal silted up for two seasons — paddy crop at risk
demo.institution: Giridih Institute of Water & Soil Engineering

submit.heading: Tell us what needs fixing
submit.intro: Describe it in your own words. There is no right way to write this — plain language is best.

description.label: What is the problem?
description.help: Say what is wrong, how long it has been like this, and who it affects.
description.placeholder: For example: the handpump near our tola has been dry for three weeks, so women walk to the next village for drinking water.

done.body: It is now on the public record and has gone to the institutions below. You can follow its progress on the challenges page.
done.matchNote: Institutions were suggested automatically from what they specialise in. Each can accept or pass.

auth.heading: Sign in to send this
auth.body: We ask for an account so you can follow what happens to your report, and so institutions can reach you if they need more detail.

error.photo: A photo could not be uploaded: {{message}}

auth.signInIntro: Use the email and password you signed up with.

why.heading: Why an account is needed
why.follow: So you can see what happened to the problem you reported, instead of it disappearing.
why.contact: So an institution can reach you if they need one more detail before starting work.
why.duplicate: So repeated reports of the same problem can be counted together and taken more seriously.
why.institutionNote: University and industry accounts are set up by the department — you cannot pick that role here.

wrongRole.heading: This page is for institutions
wrongRole.body: This area is for university and industry partners. Your account is registered as {{role}}.

institution.portalIntro: Challenges the classifier has routed to you, ranked by how well they fit — claim one to take ownership of it.
institution.notLinked: Your account is registered as an institution, but is not yet linked to a specific institution record. Contact the Department of Higher & Technical Education to complete setup.
